summary: Rebuilt and relaunched macOS Debug from current source. Bundle metadata confirms version 1.0.15 (20). The first recorded run restored the session after more than six minutes on the guild-connection splash, but a fresh current-source restart on 2026-09-30 reached SHARE_TEST quickly and successfully rendered the Pixel screen share. The earlier startup delay did not recur; its cause remains unknown.

checks.name: Current-source macOS Debug build
checks.observation: The Debug app bundle was rebuilt successfully from the current source.

checks.name: Fresh app relaunch and guild startup
checks.observation: At 20:36 local time the relaunched window showed 'Подключаемся к гильдии…'. By 20:43 local time it had restored the Pistol121 session and reached the SHARE_TEST prejoin view, displaying 'Пока никого нет.' The wait exceeded six minutes. No voice connection or microphone activation was attempted.

checks.name: Public service reachability check
checks.observation: GET https://v.bootybay.ru/api/v1/maintenance returned HTTP 200 from the host. This only verifies the public maintenance endpoint, not authenticated API or guild startup.

checks.name: Fresh restart on the connected Mac
checks.observation: Flutter rebuilt and launched the Debug app from current source (pubspec version 1.0.15+20). The existing Pistol121 session restored into SHARE_TEST within the run's approximately 30-second build/launch window. The app displayed the Android participant and later its full-screen stream.

remaining: Find why startup takes more than six minutes and verify normal startup latency after a fresh relaunch. The public maintenance endpoint returning HTTP 200 does not prove authenticated API or Keychain startup behavior.
